The Rock City Sanitarium
Corner Foster and Stewart Streets,
NASHVILLE, TENN.
A quiet health home for invalids and
sufferers from chronic ailments. Located
on an elevation, surrounded by spacious,
shady lawns.
Fully equipped for the successful
treatment of diseases of the stomach,
liver, kidneys, blood and nerves, by other
methods than drugs.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: The famous Battle Creek Methods water, in the form of baths of all kinds, sprays, douches, packs, etc., electricity, massage, Swedish movements, dieting, etc., are used under the direction of a physician of fifteen years' experience in these procedures and a graduate of the Battle Creek Sanitarium. Surgical and obstetrical cases received in special wards. Lady physician gives especial attention to diseases of women and children. Rates, $10 per week and upwards. For further information address
